what: It is a Hong Kong technology company offering cloud hosting, IT solutions and domain registration services to businesses.
proceeds: It expects about $30.2 million in net proceeds. About 30% is for blockchain and AI marketing tools, 30% for automated security checks and AI monitoring, and 40% for working capital and general needs.
risks: The Chinese government may oversee or step into the Hong Kong business, which could change its operations and sharply cut the value of its shares.
Mainland China laws might be applied to the Hong Kong operating subsidiary, which could hurt its ability to run profitably.
Following Hong Kong's personal data privacy law and related rules may be costly and could affect the business.
The Hong Kong National Security Law could affect the Hong Kong subsidiary, which makes up nearly all of the business.
Political risks of doing business in Hong Kong could harm the company.
